scope: Public source only. No installed-target equivalence assertion, runtime import, plugin execution or device query.

ipc.configuration_default: VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH defaults to tempfile.gettempdir() in envs.py

entrypoint.selection: VLLM_PLUGINS contains an exact plugin-name allowlist. Unset permits all discovered plugins; empty selects none.
entrypoint.task_requirement: Expose real pip --target wheel metadata on PYTHONPATH with committed source ahead of copied wheel code. No synthetic dist-info or entrypoint replacement.

path_override_controls.VLLM_MEDIA_CACHE: Independent explicit cache directory; defaults empty
path_override_controls.VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE_DIR: Independent explicit autotune cache directory; defaults None
path_override_controls.VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER: Independent external tuned-kernel config read location

isolation_caveat: Setting XDG_CACHE_HOME, VLLM_CACHE_ROOT and TMPDIR does not neutralize inherited independent override variables. Remove or explicitly bind them in the child environment; preserve necessary pinned toolchain/runtime paths and source-bind the environment policy.
